artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures seated in a room. The person on the left is sitting back with their legs extended, hands on their hips, holding a staff. They have long hair and a beard, wearing a hat and elaborate clothing. The person on the right is facing forward, slightly hunched over, engaging in needlework or knitting. They have a distinguished face, long hair, and loose clothing, sitting on a chair. In the background, there is a large window with buildings outside and an easel or staff leaning against the wall. The floor has a pattern.

artworks.title: Un Miracle [A Miracle]
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of staircases and archways. The image shows several figures at the base of a large staircase. Grand archways are visible, along with a shadowy area in the background. The drawing features intricate line work and shading, creating a dynamic atmosphere. It is rendered in monochrome with contrasts between light and dark areas.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with Shadowed Face, Wearing a Scarf and a Plumed Hat
artworks.description: The image showcases an abstract composition with swirling and cross-hatched lines creating a dense texture. Some shapes hint at a human face with a possible hat or headdress, along with a feather-like silhouette. The lines suggest a voluminous beard or mane around the figure, evoking the image of a person draped in a textured costume.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait(?), Wearing a Plumed Cap ["Portrait of Bernini"]
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man with long, curly hair, wearing a large hat. He has defined facial features, including a prominent nose and intense eyes. The man is depicted facing forward and wearing a cloak or draped fabric around his shoulders. The background is plain with text at the top left indicating the artist or sitter.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Long Beard and Skullcap, Leaning Forward
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of an older man's head and partial upper torso. The man is facing slightly downwards with his head inclined forward. He has a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, and a thick, full beard that extends down from his chin. His hair is long, textured, and covers his ears and part of his head. The background is a simple, textured surface with the name "CASTIGLIONE GENOVESE" inscribed on the top left.

artworks.title: Man with a Beard and a Tassled Headdress, Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a person in profile to the left. The individual has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and full lips, and dense facial hair including a thick mustache and beard. They are wearing a turban and a draped garment with fabric folds around the shoulders. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain with textured effects. An inscription in the upper left corner reads "GASTILIOII GE[NOVESE]".

artworks.title: Man with a Long Beard and Headdress, Facing Right
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a profile portrait of a man with a prominent beard and mustache, wearing an elaborate turban. The man has bold facial features, including a pronounced forehead, deep-set eyes, and a strong nose. He is facing to the right, and the background is plain. The turban has intricate detailing and a large plume or feather. There is a visible part of a draped collar around his neck, possibly indicating a richly folded garment or fur. The illustration is detailed with fine lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Bearded Man in a Fur Cap, Facing Left
artworks.description: The artwork depicts an elderly man in profile view, facing to the right. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard. He has long hair flowing down his neck and shoulders, and wears a large textured hat and a garment with a fur-lined collar. The background is plain. Etchings in the top left corner may identify the subject or artist.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Nemean Lion
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper (line block from chiaroscuro woodcut)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston, in Honor of Peter Parshall
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and shading on buff-colored paper, a nude, muscular man wrestles a lion in a landscape in this horizontal woodcut. The man and animal’s bodies curl around each other in the lower right quadrant of the scene. The man reaches over the back of the lion’s neck as the latter claws and the man’s leg. They battle on a path that runs across the picture from behind tall trees along the left edge of the composition and beyond rocky ground with scrubby plants along the bottom edge. A club leans against a stone in the lower right corner. Hills and trees roll back in space, reaching the top edge along the way. Closer inspection reveals the back end of a second lion going into a cave near the right edge of the woodcut. An inscription is included on a long rock along the bottom edge of the print. It reads, “RAPHAEL VR. INV.”

artworks.title: A Pissing Horse Bound to a Post
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.5 × 19 cm (5 11/16 × 7 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: This image portrays a lone horse near us, with its head turned slightly downward and to the right. A man sits on the ground holding the horse's reins. The horizon shows undulating hills that extend into the distance, with faint outlines of mountains. The artwork features detailed etching strokes capturing the horse's mane and the texture of the terrain. The palette is monochromatic in black and gray, emphasizing a somber feel. The sky displays fine lines hinting at a cloudy setting, while the ground has sparse vegetation and rocks.

artworks.title: A Man Holding a Horse by His Bridle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene depicting horses, dogs, and people. The central figure is a horse standing in the foreground, with a second horse and rider in the background. A dog sits next to the horse, looking up, and another dog is lying in the grass nearby. The background features cloudy skies with delicate line work, adding depth to the scene. The image is rendered in fine lines and delicate shading, typical of an etching technique, showcasing a peaceful rural setting.

artworks.title: Two Plow Horses Standing in a Field
artworks.description: The image shows two horses standing side by side on a gently rolling landscape. The point of view is as if standing a short distance away from the horses, capturing them in a natural stance. The horizon is low, highlighting the sky with clouds above. The horses are depicted with detailed and precise lines, emphasizing their muscles and facial features. The color palette is monochromatic, using light and dark tones. In the distance, there are trees and hills.

artworks.title: Two Horses Drinking at a Trough
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a rural scene. Two horses and a human figure on horseback are depicted. One horse is near a trough, while the other horse, with the rider, is drinking from it. The rider is dressed plainly with a wide-brimmed hat. In the background, a figure is walking on a path. The sky has soft clouds. The focus is on the foreground, with detailed animal forms and intricate linework creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Rearing Horse near a Stable
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene with animals and equestrian activity. Riders are depicted on horseback, with one in the foreground turning their horse. Other riders are near a building entrance. The drawing shows intricate line work for texture and depth, giving a sense of motion. There are clouds in the sky, dogs close to the riders, and architectural and natural elements in the environment.

artworks.title: A Boy Taking a Horse to Drink
artworks.description: The image shows a dynamic scene with figures and horses from a straight-on perspective. The horizon line is in the middle of the composition, providing depth between the individuals and horses in the foreground and the figures in the background. The artwork is a detailed etching with fine lines defining forms and textures like the horses and clothing. It is in a monochromatic palette of black and white, using contrasts and shadows for vividness and depth. In the foreground, a man is tugging a horse's bridle while another man on horseback raises a whip. More figures on horseback can be seen in the distance against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Two Grazing Horses
artworks.description: The image features two horses standing side by side in a flat open landscape. The horizon is low, with a line of grass and faint trees in the background. A cart with figures is visible in the distance. The horses and landscape are detailed using an etching technique with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the intricate details of the composition, including the horses' textures. The sky has wispy clouds etched with fine lines.

artworks.title: A Horse Bound to a Post
artworks.description: The image displays a side view perspective of a horse in the foreground with detailed linework, cross-hatching for depth and texture. A second horse carrying a person and a man interacting with a dog are also visible. The background shows diminishing hills and sparse nature elements. The sky features lightly etched clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with black on off-white paper.

artworks.title: A Horse Bound to a Post with a Reclining Dog
artworks.description: The image shows a horse and a dog close to us on the left side. The horse is standing with its back turned, facing slightly to the right. Next to the horse, a dog is lying down. In the background, a figure is seated on another horse, facing right. The horizon line is low, with the sky taking up a large part of the picture. Delicately drawn clouds are visible in the sky. The image is monochrome, with black and gray ink used for shading. Detailed linework is used to create texture, particularly in the depiction of the animals' fur and the figure's clothing.

artworks.title: A Pissing Horse Held by a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with figures and animals interacting. A man in rustic attire stands near a horse, facing away. To the left is an architectural structure with people gathered around it. The style features fine engravings and cross-hatched lines. The color palette is monochromatic, creating a classic feel. The image captures ordinary interactions in a rural setting.
